A '''Coruscant Security Force paramedic''' was a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] employed by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. They responded to situations with CSF [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] where injuries may occur requiring them to be treated quickly.
